# What is RAFE?

(TODO) Brief recap of the Sharpe-gap bound from Salcher, Stöckl & Hanke (2026,
*Journal of Forecasting*): $\Delta \le c \cdot \mathrm{RAFE} + SR^{\ast} \cdot
\mathrm{C\text{-}RAFE}$. RAFE is a Mahalanobis-type mean error; C-RAFE is an
operator-norm covariance error; their sum is T-RAFE.
